name: vxture-design
description: Vxture Design System — design tokens, UI components, umbrella package and preview surface.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @vxture/design-tokens build && pnpm --filter @vxture/design-ui build && pnpm --filter @vxture/design-system build
scripts.lint:design-tokens: node scripts/design-tokens/generate-primitive.mjs --check && node scripts/design-tokens/generate-semantic.mjs --check && node scripts/design-tokens/generate-semantic-scales.mjs --check && node scripts/design-tokens/generate-theme.mjs --check && node scripts/design-tokens/generate-token-ts.mjs --check && node scripts/design-tokens/check-utilities.mjs && node scripts/guardrails/check-mode-blocks.mjs
scripts.guardrails: pnpm lint:design-tokens && pnpm lint:design && pnpm lint:design-classes && pnpm lint:design-exports && pnpm lint:design-preview && pnpm lint:design-i18n && pnpm lint:control-chars && pnpm lint:doc-shape && pnpm lint:server-entry && pnpm lint:packed-consumability
